001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import com.google.common.collect.MapMaker;
004import org.bukkit.block.Block;
005import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.Map;
011import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
012
013public class InventoryWrapperRegistry {
014
015  private final Map<String, InventoryWrapperManager> registry = new MapMaker().makeMap();
016  private final List<String> registrationOrder = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
017
018  @Nullable
019  public String find(final InventoryWrapperManager manager) {
020
021    for(final Map.Entry<String, InventoryWrapperManager> entry : registry.entrySet()) {
022      if(entry.getValue() == manager || entry.getValue().equals(manager)) {
023        return entry.getKey();
024      }
025    }
026    return null;
027  }
028
029  @Nullable
030  public InventoryWrapperManager get(final String pluginName) {
031
032    return registry.get(pluginName);
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Resolves a block inventory using registered block inventory providers. Providers are queried in
037   * registration order, which keeps QuickShop's built-in Bukkit inventory handling as the primary
038   * path and compatibility providers as fallbacks.
039   *
040   * @param block block to inspect
041   *
042   * @return a live inventory wrapper, or {@code null} when no provider supports the block
043   */
044  @Nullable
045  public InventoryWrapper resolve(@NotNull final Block block) {
046
047    for(final String providerName : registrationOrder) {
048      final InventoryWrapperManager manager = registry.get(providerName);
049      if(manager instanceof final BlockInventoryWrapperManager blockManager) {
050        final InventoryWrapper wrapper = blockManager.resolve(block);
051        if(wrapper != null) {
052          return wrapper;
053        }
054      }
055    }
056    return null;
057  }
058
059  public void register(@NotNull final Plugin plugin, @NotNull final InventoryWrapperManager manager) {
060
061    if(registry.containsKey(plugin.getName())) {
062      plugin.getLogger().warning("Nag Author: Plugin " + plugin.getName() + " already have a registered InventoryWrapperManager: "
063                                 + registry.get(plugin.getName()).getClass().getName() +
064                                 " but trying register another new manager: " + manager.getClass().getName() +
065                                 ". This may cause unexpected behavior! Replacing with new instance...");
066    } else {
067      registrationOrder.add(plugin.getName());
068    }
069    registry.put(plugin.getName(), manager);
070  }
071
072  public void unregister(@NotNull final Plugin plugin) {
073
074    registry.remove(plugin.getName());
075    registrationOrder.remove(plugin.getName());
076  }
077
078}
